notes.title: Party Maker New Year's update
notes.content:
We have been reading and listening to your feedback and we hear you! More enjoyment - you say. Why is it ending already? With the next update, we're adding the ability to replay all completed levels after finishing the game. So, you can return to your favorite spot and have another go, this time with all the decorations unlocked.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36658449/bf31e876ba3ae5778ed9ebd231fae746318ae900.jpg[/img]

At the beginning of the new year, we will also provide a brand-new location!

We can't wait for your new compositions. Be sure to share them with us.

Let’s stay in touch!

Forestlight Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1125890/Party_Maker/

notes.title: NEW NAME BETTER GAME
notes.content:
Let’s go with a short summary:

[list]
[*] Published the update of the prologue (with highly wanted fixes, improvements and changes).

[*] Tested and balanced the gameplay.
[*] Added some minor details to our office, including photos from events you participated in.
[*] We are constantly optimizing to generate as many fps as possible. We increased our testers group.
[/list]

Hang on tight, more info coming soon.

notes.title: Wedding Designer Prologue - Language update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931031/71345e366000c8c6dae5a9c743ab4c431881f17e.jpg[/img]

[b]Hello, Wedding Designer Prologue community![/b]

For the last couple of weeks, a lot of you reported problems with translations to your languages. we took all the feedback to heart and had the whole game re-translated. 

We hope that for now, everything will be more clear, and your experience with the game will be a lot better.

Change Log:

Fixed translation issues for:
[list]
[*] Polish
[*] German
[*] Spanish
[*] Italian
[*] Russian
[*] Turkish
[*] Chinese
[*] English
[*] French
[*] Portuguese
[*] Korean
[/list]

notes.title: Wedding Designer Prologue Update 2
notes.content:
Hello, Wedding Designer community!

We are happy to present you second big update to the Wedding Designer Prologue. 

We are still getting a lot of feedback, thanks to all of you for your help. Your ideas are always helpful when we work on new updates to the game.

Changes:
- Achievements on steam !!!
- Markings on the minimap.
- Corrected fonts.
- Minor changes to the quest with animals
- Optimization

Also, we are thankful for all Steam reviews. They are very important for us, so if you played Prologue, we will be honored if you leave your review on the Steam site.

[b]If you have any issues with the game, join our Discord community. It's the fastest way to get your answers.[/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/mEvYF5vDaA][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931031/1828de088d8457f88d4fe698dfb4a19dea0e7c7b.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Wedding Designer Prologue Update v1.1b
notes.content:
[h3]Thank you very much for the kind reception of the Wedding Designer Prologue. It's crazy how much positive feedback we got.[/h3]

Of course, we care about all ideas, and problems as much as we care about all positive feedback. 

That's why we recently released a big update that covers most of the problems you already reported.

- We have lowered the volume of the music in cutscenes.
- The time needed to beat Uncle Bob in the race is easier by 2 seconds.
- Animals in the headphone quest are now much easier to find.
- Hanging draperies shouldn't be a problem now.
- The tutorial on picking up garbage in the office has been changed. 
- We've added the ability to disable head bob in the options
- Quest with better results in the race is now hidden.
- There is now an option to skip the race quest.

Also, we are thankful for all Steam reviews. They are very important for us, so if you played Prologue, we will be honored if you leave your review on the Steam site. 
[b]
If you have any issues with the game, join our Discord community. It's the fastest way to get your answers.[/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/mEvYF5vDaA][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931031/1828de088d8457f88d4fe698dfb4a19dea0e7c7b.png[/img][/url]
